Barcelona
Street Run

Drive the Eixample grid, Avinguda Diagonal and the seafront, then take the Ronda out past Camp Nou and Montjuïc into the countryside and a race circuit. The real streets and buildings of Barcelona: walk into any shop or bar, dive the coral reef off Barceloneta, fish off the pier, climb the Rabassada road, switch on police chases. Seven cars, nine missions, real tyre grip and suspension.
